related_questions.question: What is the schedule for the flu shot?
related_questions.snippet: For best results, it's recommended to get your shot any time between September and October. If those months aren't convenient, you can also get your flu shot later in the season. Peak flu season in the United States is generally between December and February.

related_questions.question: How far in advance should I get a flu shot?
related_questions.snippet: The CDC recommends that people ages 6 months and older get a flu vaccine, ideally by the end of October. Even if you wait until after October, the vaccine will still be beneficial and provide protection.
related_questions.title: It's a Good Time to Get Your Flu Vaccine - FDA

related_questions.question: How to get the flu vaccine for free?
related_questions.snippet: You can get vaccinated at your doctor's office or find locations to get a flu shot at most pharmacies, county health departments and urgent care centers. If you don't have insurance, you can still get a free or low-cost flu shot at your local community clinic or public health department.
